label: sparse D1-only feature, weakly enriched after consecutive unrewarded trials
explanation: Fires only at D1 (100% of mass; never at GO or D2), but on only ~7% of D1 steps, so phase==D1 alone has recall 1.0 and precision 0.07. Inside D1 no simple condition picks out the active steps. The best observed-only predicate, D1 after two unrewarded trials in a row (a losing streak), reaches dev F1 0.24 (precision 0.23, recall 0.25, mass recall 0.32). The top windows show long r0 streaks, often a2 choices leading rarely to S1, with activation rising along the streak. Other weak enrichments: D1 inputs where the agent fails to fixate (5x lift, but rare); prev_action a1; intermediate value (7.1-7.7) and intermediate choice logit; mid-episode (rate drops to near zero in trials 90-99 and is zero in trials 0-2). Banding by value or choice keeps recall (~0.5-0.7) but precision stays ~0.1. Future variables (stay, reward) add nothing beyond about 2.7x lift for an upcoming switch. Recorded the losing-streak predicate as the closest coherent description; it is not an explanation.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: phase=D1 & before=a2 S1 u (+5.93), phase=D1 & before=a1 S1 u (+5.45), phase=D1 & choice_bin=decile 1 (9 = most a1) (+3.48), phase=D1 & value_bin=decile 7 (9 = highest) (+2.58), phase=D1 & choice_bin=decile 6 (9 = most a1) (+1.96), ep_bucket=3 (+1.72). Lower it: prev_state=2 (-10.13), phase=GO (-6.29), phase=D2 (-6.22), before=a1 S2 r (-4.35).
